description: Defines data models for reviews, including individual review details and aggregated review statistics, used within a restaurant review application.

classes.name: Review
classes.description: Represents a user review of an item, including user details, rating, comment, photo URLs, creation timestamp, and a featured flag.

classes.name: ReviewAggregate
classes.description: Summarizes multiple reviews with average stars, total review count, and the most reviewed item IDs.
